title.fr_fr: Clé USB (données de simulation de particules)

content.en_us:
How to get it :
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] (x2) : [[gv:drive_flash_particlesim|Flash Drive (Particle Simulation Data)]], [[gv:drive_flash_empty|Flash Drive (Empty)]].
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] : [[gv:drive_flash_empty|Flash Drive (Empty)]], 16000 mB helium4.
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] : [[gv:drive_flash_empty|Flash Drive (Empty)]], 16000 mB perfluoromethyl cold.
(1 more recipes: see JEI.)

Used to make :
[[gv:struct_torus_core|Fusion Reactor Vessel Core Component]].
